title: incident-bot: oncall runbook autodiagnostics enhancements
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds improvements to incident-bot's oncall runbook auto-diagnostics: ranking of runbook suggestions by recent success, contextual tag matching, and compact summaries for quick consumption by oncall. Includes UI changes to the Slack/Teams brief and server-side throttling to avoid noisy recommendations. Addresses flakiness observed during the Nov 2025 SEV when runbook suggestions caused alert fatigue. This is a single cohesive change set that updates the diagnostics ranking model, runbook query heuristics, and runbook metadata extraction pipeline. Includes migration for existing runbook metadata and fallbacks to previous heuristics to preserve behavior during rollout.
commits: feat: add runbook suggestion ranking and success-rate signal
perf: cache recent runbook outcomes to reduce DB queries
chore: add migration to populate runbook success metatags
docs: update runbook suggestion guide and playbook templates
review_comments: Diego Morales: Left a couple nits around error handling in matcher.go; suggestion to return typed errors for telemetry
Claire Nguyen: Can we add a short-circuit to skip ranking when runbook outcome history is empty to avoid misleading scores?
Samir Rao: Approved after second CI run — observed 12% reduction in average API latency for diagnostics endpoint during load tests
Asha Patel: Thanks — implemented typed errors and short-circuit in 2nd commit, added unit tests and updated docs
checks: E2E: slack-integration — pass (observed ephemeral failures on first run)
review_conversation: Diego Morales requested tighter error typing and a guard around empty history; I implemented both and added tests. Integration tests initially failed due to a race in the metadata migrator — fixed with a simple mutex and retriable backoff. Once green, Samir ran a perf canary against a staging SLO and confirmed reduced latency and no increase in suggestion noise. Final approval from Claire on 2025-12-01.
release_notes: Enhancement: oncall runbook autodiagnostics now rank suggestions by recent success rate and context tags; reduces noise and improves suggestion relevance. Migration included: populates runbook success metatags; rollout is behind a feature flag.
